extracted.name: 2022 Pork Roast Grilled
ingredient_lines: Lean Boneless Pork Loin (this one is about 2.4 Lbs)
Olive Oil 3-tbs. (any type that won't burn while over heat)
Salt & pepper (or any all-purpose seasoning/aromatic frankly)
instruction_lines: I put olive oil in any pan or plate. Roll the meat in oil to cover all surfaces. I lightly seasoned with salt & pepper.

After onion & garlic is put through blender, evenly cover all sides of meat. Now I fire up grill to pre heat after meat is seasoned and ready to begin two hours of cooking. I let meat absorb aromatics for 15 mins or so.
On low burner setting, lid shut, I cook meat one hour on fatty side first. Only once I flip meat and grill for additional hour resulting a beautiful look, tenderness, and taste!
